Everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder waiting on a real value: brand name, the four prices, email, WhatsApp, Telegram.

The same values live in lib/offer.ts in the repo, so the page and this canvas can be updated together.
The globe here is drawn as SVG. On the live page it is the cobe canvas from components/ui/globe.tsx — it spins, and you can drag it.
